questions.question: What did Israel set up to remember crossing the Jordan?
Why were the twelve stones set up?
options: As a memorial and sign for future generations
As a boundary marker set between all the tribes
As the foundation of a future city
As a decoration for the new altar
questions.answer: As a memorial and sign for future generations

questions.question: One man from each of the twelve tribes took a stone from the Jordan.
Twelve _____ were taken from the middle of the Jordan as a memorial.
The stones were a sign so children would ask about the _____ crossing.
